channel.title: AI Threat Watch: KE
channel.description: Verified case files located in KE.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Hacked Raila Odinga X account posts deepfake endorsing crypto token to scam Kenyans
item.description: A deepfake video of former PM Raila Odinga endorsing the Kenya Token was posted from his reportedly hacked X account and removed the same evening; unconfirmed data suggested 20 percent of supply was bought soon after. Target: Kenyan crypto buyers. KE. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI videos of President Ruto resigning hit 1.4M views on TikTok during Kenya protests
item.description: During deadly protests, AI videos built on State House footage showed Ruto announcing his resignation; one TikTok clip drew over 1.4 million views before deletion and Africa Check rated the claims false. Target: Kenyan public; President William Ruto. KE. Verification: confirmed.
